nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (Every 6h)
nodes.notes: Runs API test suite every 6 hours

nodes.name: 1. Login - Get Tokens
nodes.notes: Endpoint 1: POST /api/auth/login — returns accessToken + refreshToken

nodes.name: Fetch OpenAPI Spec
nodes.notes: Pulls the live OpenAPI/Swagger spec for contract validation

nodes.name: Parse OpenAPI Endpoints
nodes.notes: Extracts all 15 endpoints from the spec for systematic testing

values.content: You are an expert airline API test engineer. Generate comprehensive test cases for airline REST APIs including positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases.

=Generate test cases for these airline API endpoints:

{{ JSON.stringify($json.endpoints.slice(0,5), null, 2) }}

For each endpoint provide:
1. Positive test: valid request with expected 2xx response
2. Negative test: invalid/missing fields expecting 4xx
3. Boundary test: min/max values for string lengths, numbers
4. Auth test: missing or expired token expecting 401

Return as JSON array with: { endpoint, testType, description, payload, expectedStatus, slaThresholdMs }

nodes.name: AI: Generate Test Cases
nodes.notes: Uses GPT-4o to generate positive, negative, boundary, and auth test cases from the spec

nodes.name: 2. Test: GET /airports
nodes.notes: Endpoint 4: GET /api/airports — list all airports (positive test)

nodes.name: 3. Test: GET /airports/JFK
nodes.notes: Endpoint 5: GET /api/airports/:code — boundary test with valid 3-char IATA code

nodes.name: 4. Test: GET /flights/search
nodes.notes: Endpoint 6: GET /api/flights/search — positive test with valid origin/destination/date/class

nodes.name: 5. Test: GET /flights/FL001
nodes.notes: Endpoint 7: GET /api/flights/:id — fetch specific flight details

nodes.name: 6. Test: GET /seats/FL001
nodes.notes: Endpoint 8: GET /api/seats/:flightId — seat availability for business class

nodes.name: 7. Test: POST /passengers
nodes.notes: Endpoint 9: POST /api/passengers — create new passenger profile

nodes.name: 8. Test: GET /passengers/P001
nodes.notes: Endpoint 10: GET /api/passengers/:id — retrieve passenger by ID

nodes.name: 9. Test: POST /bookings
nodes.notes: Endpoint 11: POST /api/bookings — create a new flight booking

nodes.name: 10. Test: GET /bookings/BK001
nodes.notes: Endpoint 12: GET /api/bookings/:id — get booking with flight and passenger details

nodes.name: 11. Refresh Access Token
nodes.notes: Endpoint 2: POST /api/auth/refresh — rotate tokens mid-workflow (simulates 15min expiry)

nodes.name: 12. Test: POST /check-in
nodes.notes: Endpoint 14: POST /api/check-in — online check-in with fresh refreshed token

nodes.name: 13. Test: GET /baggage/allowance
nodes.notes: Endpoint 16 (GET /api/baggage/allowance) — economy baggage rules

nodes.name: 14. Test: POST /payments
nodes.notes: Endpoint 15: POST /api/payments — process payment for booking

nodes.name: 15. Test: PUT /bookings/cancel (Neg)
nodes.notes: Endpoint 13: PUT /api/bookings/:id/cancel — NEGATIVE test: cancel checked-in booking → expects 403

nodes.name: Collect & Analyse Results
nodes.notes: Aggregates all 15 test results, computes pass rate, SLA violations, and overall health

values.content: You are an expert API QA analyst. Classify API failures and provide root cause analysis for airline APIs.

=Analyse these airline API test failures:

{{ JSON.stringify($json.results.filter(r => r.status !== 'PASS'), null, 2) }}

For each failure, classify into:
1. CONTRACT_BREACH - Schema/response contract mismatch
2. AUTH_FAILURE - Authentication/authorization issue  
3. ENVIRONMENT_ISSUE - Infrastructure/network problem
4. LOGIC_ERROR - Business logic bug
5. SLA_VIOLATION - Response time exceeded

Provide: classification, severity (P1/P2/P3), rootCause, suggestedFix, impactedPassengers

nodes.name: AI: Root Cause Analysis
nodes.notes: GPT-4o classifies failures: CONTRACT_BREACH / AUTH_FAILURE / ENVIRONMENT_ISSUE / LOGIC_ERROR / SLA_VIOLATION

parameters.summary: =[AIRLINE API FAILURE] {{ $('Collect & Analyse Results').first().json.summary.testRunId }} — {{ $('Collect & Analyse Results').first().json.summary.failed }} endpoint(s) failed

nodes.name: Create Jira Issue
nodes.notes: Auto-raises a P1/P2 Jira bug with full failure details + AI root cause analysis

nodes.name: Slack Alert (Failure)
nodes.notes: Posts failure summary with Jira link to #airline-api-alerts Slack channel

nodes.name: Slack Notify (Success)
nodes.notes: Posts green status to Slack when all 15 API tests pass

nodes.name: Logout & Revoke Tokens
nodes.notes: Endpoint 3: POST /api/auth/logout — invalidate tokens at end of test run
